text: 1.Photocopy of the passportThe passport must have an expiry date after September of the year you apply, if the validity of the applicant's current passport does not meet the requirement, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high school(Both Chinese Version and English Version)4. Academic transcript of high school(Both Chinese Version and English Version)5. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.6. Photocopy of Physical Examination Record.Applicants should strictly check the items in accordance with the requirements of Physical Examination Record.pdf Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending doctor, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The date shall be after October 1, 2023. The original piece is required during registration.7. Self-introduction videoApplicants are required to upload a video of self-introduction within one minute, and those who have HSK certificates must use Chinese to introduce themselves.
